Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF ltrim(to_char(:seq),'1234567890') is not null THEN
 show_error('1707');
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN value_error THEN
 null;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 If :location_id is null then
 return;
 end if;
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from vserv_master
 where code_type='LTYPE' and code=:location_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Err: Invalid location');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 If :client_host is null then
 return;
 End if;
 
 If :code_type = 'OASVR' then 
 If LTrim(:client_host,'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ-_') is not null then
 message ('Err: Invalid Host name');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 Else
 null;
 End If;

 Else
 message ('Err: Invalid code type');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End If;
 
exception
 when others then 
 null;
end;
